building-hero.subject: riveted steel gun shop with a neon IRON SIGHT ARMS sign, a projecting neon pistol sign, lit display windows, yellow bollards and a long shooting range wing lettered RANGE
building-hero.notes: The building stands alone on white: keep its signs, bollards, pavement slab and rooftop gear.

building-front.subject: front elevation of a riveted steel gun shop with a neon IRON SIGHT ARMS sign and lit display windows

building-side.subject: side elevation of the long shooting range wing of a riveted steel gun shop, lettered RANGE

building-shop.subject: front shop block of a riveted steel gun shop seen from its corner: a neon IRON SIGHT ARMS sign, a projecting neon pistol sign, lit display windows, a glazed double door, yellow bollards and rooftop air units
building-shop.notes: This picture is one section cut from a longer building. Draw only this section as a standalone block of the same height and proportions; where the picture is cut, close the block with a plain grey wall, adding no doors, signs or equipment to it. The sign reads IRON SIGHT ARMS and, below it, WEAPONS, AMMO, GEAR, RANGE, spelled exactly so.

building-range.subject: long shooting range wing of a riveted steel gun shop seen from the side: two bands of mesh windows, RANGE painted in white with three chevrons, red stripes, a hazard-striped steel door under a lamp and rooftop air units
building-range.notes: This picture is one section cut from a longer building. Draw only this section as a standalone block of the same height and proportions; where the picture is cut, close the block with a plain grey wall, adding no doors, signs or equipment to it.
